name: Shillong
description: Capital of Meghalaya and headquarters of East Khasi Hills, known as the Scotland of the East. Colonial hill station at about 1,500 m elevation with pine forests, markets, lakes, and base for exploring waterfalls, caves, and living root bridges.
facts: State capital and HQ of East Khasi Hills
Named after the deity U Shyllong
Major educational and administrative hub of Northeast India
